title: V5: resumed-state seal throughput — propose coalesce + attest wake (depth fix)
notes: Owner: suppression stats worsened on 0.1.66 (543c997). Rolled back coalesce+attest_wake in tree; see docs/debug/20260608-v5-rollback-coalesce-wake.md. Re-queue only after resumed-state A/B.
brief: Iterative debug (docs/debug/20260606): resumed ~34k state T100~158s vs fresh ~108s; pending_ticks p50 330 vs 45 — depth-amplified gate/poll + propose churn (~23x/seal prior). seal-on-gate-ready insufficient. Implement production fixes: (1) propose coalescing — at most one effective wire propose per (next_h, round) until seal or height advance; dedupe ahead+deadline tick+heartbeat paths; (2) attest wake — after grid deadline, notify seal loop on ClusterAttest so gate-ready does not wait poll_ms×N; preserve invariants: no seal before next_seal_time_ms, ahead=propose-only. Target resumed CY: T100 ≤115s, pending p50 <80, struck <5% steady.
